verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Customer Agent works as a team member inside Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, or Pylon. Its own changelog says the Pylon integration resolves tickets across email, live chat, and Slack, and an API lets the agent run outside a ticketing system. Channel reach is inherited from the connected ticketing system rather than offered as native omnichannel, and WhatsApp, social, and in-app are never named. missing for 10: documented WhatsApp support, social channel support, an in-app widget, native channel coverage independent of the ticketing tool, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, one agent covers chat, email, and in-app, plus the channels my customers actually use — Slack, WhatsApp, social
